name: Washington State Legislative Districts 2024 (Remedial Map 3B)
publisher: Washington State Office of Financial Management, via the Washington Geospatial Open Data Portal
legal_basis: Court-ordered map, Soto Palmer v. Hobbs, No. 3:22-cv-05035-RSL (W.D. Wash., order of March 15, 2024); used for the 2024 and 2026 elections
processing: mapshaper 0.6.102: -simplify dp interval=5 keep-shapes (topology-preserving, max 5 m deviation); -points inner for label positions; coordinates rounded to 1e-6 degrees
verification: 49 districts (1-49); largest district-area change 0.013% (LD 47), median 0.0015%; no overlaps or gaps between districts
note: Boundaries include water areas, as in the official data.
